blocks.text: MIN:000–022 DETAILED REVIEW AND DELEGATED APPROVAL — CANONICAL

The packet challenged every Phase 2 meaning against four alternative architectures, scored 45 candidates, supplied tailored runtime-state and lexical-trit distinctions, audited eleven competing families, and ran 91 unique English Mind concept tests. The pre-approval gate passed 21 checks and all 2,592 deterministic generation assertions. A separate post-migration validation passed 17 checks.

Canonical architecture: the Mind entity layer names cognitive representations. The second trit selects self-representation, target representation, or a shared cognitive schema; the third selects persistent, presently manifest, or latent expression.
MIN:000 — persistent self-representation — A mental representation of the cognizer’s own identity or condition that persists across cognitive episodes.
MIN:001 — manifest self-representation — A mental representation of the cognizer’s own identity or condition that is presently manifest in cognition.
MIN:002 — latent self-representation — A mental representation of the cognizer’s own identity or condition that persists without presently manifesting in cognition.
MIN:010 — persistent target representation — A mental representation of a distinct target that persists across cognitive episodes.
MIN:011 — manifest target representation — A mental representation of a distinct target that is presently manifest in cognition.
MIN:012 — latent target representation — A mental representation of a distinct target that persists without presently manifesting in cognition.
MIN:020 — persistent shared cognitive schema — A mental representation held in common across multiple cognizers that persists across cognitive episodes.
MIN:021 — manifest shared cognitive schema — A mental representation held in common across multiple cognizers that is presently manifest among them.
MIN:022 — latent shared cognitive schema — A mental representation held in common across multiple cognizers that persists without presently manifesting among them.

Design boundary: MIN:0xx owns representational content as a mental entity or condition. It does not absorb attention allocation, perception, recall, learning, reasoning, competence, belief commitment, truth, external records, communication, social tradition, living identity, or physical neural state. Those meanings remain for later MIN layers, other families, grammar, or explicit compounds.
